guidance: Compare sugar only when both products use the same serving or per-100-g basis. Check ingredient names that may indicate added sugars.
Keyword screening cannot confirm allergen safety. Check the package allergen statement and cross-contamination warning.
Ingredient names and additives may be ambiguous. Check the vegetarian/non-vegetarian mark and manufacturer information.
Compare sodium values only when units and serving basis match.
Compare fiber between products using the same serving basis and consider the rest of the diet.
OCR may misread decimal points, digits, units or columns. Manually verify extracted values against the physical package.
This application is an informational decision-support tool, not a diagnosis or substitute for a qualified clinician or dietitian.
